title: sporobolus asper var. clandestinus
intro: Sporobolus asper var. clandestinus, commonly known as Clandestine Saltgrass or Clandestine Prairie Grass, is a variety of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Sporobolus asper var. clandestinus include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
